title: Rocky Mountain National Park Guided Hiking Adventure
includes: Small-Group Adventure – Maximum 10 guests for a more personal experience.
Water Refills Available – Bring a reusable bottle and stay hydrated all day.
Customized Trail Selection – Hikes chosen daily based on conditions and group ability.
Photo Opportunities – Scenic stops and guide-recommended viewpoints.
We provide MicroSpikes in the Winter
Expert Hiking Guide – Professional guides trained in mountain safety and navigation
Wildlife & Nature Expertise – Learn about local wildlife, ecology, and geology.
Winter Weather Clothing (Coats, gloves, hats, etc.) (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

This is a moderate hike at altitude that many guests may find challenging. This tour is not recommended for people who do not regularly exercise. Out of respect for the other guests on the tour, please consider our Rocky Mountain National Park sightseeing tour if you are unsure if you can meet the physical requirements. Our guides reserve the right to ask guests to stop or turn around on the hike.
policies: Lunch Included - You must call tour operator, IF you have dietary restrictions
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
We cannot guarantee a specific trail - we chose based on day, condition, crowds.
From November to April, waterproof shoes are highly recommended. Wool socks are also recommended.
Winter weather conditions may exist in the park, please dress adequately for potentially snowy conditions and low temperatures.

Lunch Policy for Late Bookings Please note that sandwich orders are placed 24 hours in advance of each tour. Reservations made within 24 hours of the tour start time will not include lunch. Guests booking last-minute are encouraged to bring their own lunch or plan to purchase food during the tour, if time and location allow.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We've got the vans and the gear you need to get out and explore Rocky Mountain National Park this winter. Join us on a moderate 4-5 mile hike, where you'll have ample time to take in the stunning mountain views. Immerse yourself in nature's solitude, and scan the scenery for elk, raptors, and bighorn sheep. Enjoy your day in the park and we'll have you back downtown in time for happy hour. Book your Rocky Mountain National Park adventure today!

Our guides are extremely experienced in the mountain environment and know the best routes to take based on the conditions and snow pack. Safety is our number one priority, and last-minute changes in itinerary may be necessary. But we guarantee any tour you take with us will be an unforgettable experience!
